gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioma; Glioblastoma; Metastatic Malignant Neoplasm in the Brain

source_quote.quote: Concentrations of D-2HG in microdialysate will be descriptively compared between patients with IDH mutated gliomas and those with IDH wildtype gliomas.

coder_notes: Diagnostic/biomarker-discovery microdialysis study with only procedure interventions (microdialysis, MRI, CT); no drug given. Cohorts I and II are both experimental-type arms with no control function; brain metastases and epileptic focus patients are also enrolled but this is not a solid-tumour basket.
